answer: Escrowed Task Trail. Each new identity must complete paid micro-tasks whose rewards unlock only after a delay; clones earn nothing until then. Ledger shards are partitioned by a random meadow assignment, so a clone’s work is isolated and unrewarded. To wander across shards, an identity posts a refundable deposit forfeited on abandonment. The terrace of eligible identities is capped by a slow-moving quota; excess clones wait out the timer. Attacker cost: per-clone deposit plus idle time, guaranteeing negative marginal EV.
